candidate.source: functionally retained candidate supplied to the downstream agent

parameters.$attack_window: trial parameter inferred and recorded before simulation
parameters.$candidate_activation_event: trial parameter inferred and recorded before simulation
parameters.$candidate_activation_phase: trial parameter inferred and recorded before simulation
parameters.$derived_bounded_post_release_window: bounded campaign parameter inferred from the feature definition and RTL, then frozen before simulation

feature_contract.provenance: independent threat definition and RTL semantics; no downstream implementation or result input
feature_contract.trial_parameter_policy: candidate bits, legal values, seeds, repetitions, and bounded timing sweeps are inferred and recorded before simulation; they do not create additional semantic scenarios
feature_contract.definition: Measure bounded progress disruption and sustained legitimate service-rate loss under candidate blocking.
feature_contract.execution_model: matched legal workloads in baseline and bounded SA0/SA1 candidate-blocking runs followed by release

calculation.progress_disruption: normalized added delay, finite stall, timeout/recovery, or failure to recover within the post-release bound
calculation.service_rate_degradation: max(0, 1 - N_fault/N_base) using legitimate completed services

validity_policy: no unrelated reset or illegal environment behavior occurs

classification.not_applicable: candidate lacks the required service role
classification.invalid: legal workload, activation, release, or knownness requirement fails

applicability.candidate_scope: candidate with a legal RTL path for this scenario
